name: Trello
description: Trigger workflows from cards created, moved, commented on or due soon on a Trello board, and create, update, move, comment on, label, archive, read and search cards from a step.

triggers.label: A card is created
triggers.description: Fires once for each card created on the board since the last poll, oldest first.

env.name: TRELLO_API_KEY
env.description: The Power-Up API key: create a Power-Up at https://trello.com/power-ups/admin, open its API Key tab and generate a key.
env.builderHint: Sent as the key query parameter on every call, never as a header. The guide calls keys public, but one is only useful with the token it authorized, so it is kept secret too. There is no Trello CLI to borrow a login from.

env.name: TRELLO_TOKEN
env.description: The member token the API key’s Token link grants: approve read and write access with expiration never, then copy the token shown.
env.builderHint: Sent as the token query parameter on every call. The link is /1/authorize?expiration=never&scope=read,write&response_type=token&key=<apiKey>. A revoked or wrong token answers 401 with the text "invalid token".

env.name: TRELLO_BOARD_ID
env.description: The board the triggers watch, by id or by the short link from its URL (trello.com/b/<shortLink>/…).
env.builderHint: Only the triggers read it; every action takes its own ids. listBoards returns the ids of every board the token can see.

env.name: TRELLO_TO_LIST_ID
env.description: For the card-moved trigger: only fire when a card lands in this list. Blank fires on every move.
env.builderHint: Compared with data.listAfter.id of each updateCard:idList action; listLists returns the ids of a board’s lists.

env.name: TRELLO_WITHIN_HOURS
env.description: For the card-due-soon trigger: how many hours ahead a due date must fall to fire.
env.builderHint: Applied here, not by the API: the board’s open cards are read and kept when due is between now and now plus this many hours and dueComplete is false.

triggers.label: A card moves to another list
triggers.description: Fires once for each card moved between lists on the board, with the list before and after. Set a destination list to fire only on arrivals there.

actions.label: Create a card
actions.description: Add a card to a list.

inputs.label: List
inputs.description: The id of the list the card should be created in.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as idList on POST /cards; listLists returns the ids of a board’s lists.

inputs.label: Name
inputs.description: The name for the card.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as name; the API allows it empty, the connector does not.

inputs.label: Description
inputs.description: The description for the card, Markdown.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as desc, only when given.

inputs.label: Due date
inputs.description: A due date for the card, ISO 8601 such as 2026-09-18T12:00:00.000Z.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as due; "The API expects a ISO 8601 date format".

inputs.label: Label ids
inputs.description: Comma-separated ids of labels to add to the card.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as idLabels, comma-separated as the reference wants; whitespace around commas is removed.

inputs.label: Member ids
inputs.description: Comma-separated ids of members to add to the card.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as idMembers, comma-separated; whitespace around commas is removed.

inputs.label: Position
inputs.description: top, bottom, or a positive number for the card’s place in the list.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as pos; the reference allows "top, bottom, or a positive float".

outputs.description: True when the card is archived
Whether the due date is marked complete
The board the card is on
The list the card is in
Labels on the card: id, name, color
The short link in the card URL
When the card last changed, ISO 8601

actions.label: Update a card
actions.description: Change the name, description, due date, due-complete flag or archived state of a card; only the inputs given are sent.

inputs.label: Card
inputs.description: The card id (24 hex characters) or the short link from its URL, trello.com/c/<shortLink>.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the path segment of /cards/{id}; an unknown id answers 400 with a plain-text body such as "invalid id", or 404.

inputs.label: Name
inputs.description: The new name for the card.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as name on PUT /cards/{id}, only when given.

inputs.label: Description
inputs.description: The new description for the card.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as desc, only when given.

inputs.label: Due date
inputs.description: When the card is due, ISO 8601, or the word null to clear it.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as due; the reference documents "null" as the value that clears the date.

inputs.label: Due complete
inputs.description: Whether the due date is marked complete.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as dueComplete=true or false, only when given.

inputs.label: Archived
inputs.description: True archives the card, false restores it.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as closed=true or false, only when given.

outputs.description: True when the card is archived
Whether the due date is marked complete
The board the card is on
The list the card is in
Labels on the card: id, name, color
The short link in the card URL
When the card last changed, ISO 8601

actions.label: Move a card
actions.description: Move a card to a list, optionally at a position or onto another board.

inputs.label: Card
inputs.description: The card id (24 hex characters) or the short link from its URL, trello.com/c/<shortLink>.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the path segment of /cards/{id}; an unknown id answers 400 with a plain-text body such as "invalid id", or 404.

inputs.label: List
inputs.description: The id of the list the card should be in.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as idList on PUT /cards/{id}.

inputs.label: Position
inputs.description: top, bottom, or a positive number for the card’s place in the list.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as pos; the reference allows "top, bottom, or a positive float".

inputs.label: Board
inputs.description: The id of the board the card should be on, for a move across boards.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as idBoard, only when given; the list must belong to that board.

outputs.description: True when the card is archived
Whether the due date is marked complete
The board the card is on
The list the card is in
Labels on the card: id, name, color
The short link in the card URL
When the card last changed, ISO 8601

inputs.label: Card
inputs.description: The card id (24 hex characters) or the short link from its URL, trello.com/c/<shortLink>.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the path segment of /cards/{id}; an unknown id answers 400 with a plain-text body such as "invalid id", or 404.

inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: The comment, Markdown.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as text on POST /cards/{id}/actions/comments.

outputs.description: When the comment was posted, ISO 8601
text, card { id, name, shortLink }, board and list

actions.label: Add a label to a card
actions.description: Put a label on a card. A label already on the card is reported as present rather than as a failure.

inputs.label: Card
inputs.description: The card id (24 hex characters) or the short link from its URL, trello.com/c/<shortLink>.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the path segment of /cards/{id}; an unknown id answers 400 with a plain-text body such as "invalid id", or 404.

inputs.label: Label
inputs.description: The id of the label to add.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as value on POST /cards/{id}/idLabels; a repeat answers 400 saying the label is already on the card, which the action treats as success.

outputs.description: The card’s label ids as the API returned them
True when the label was on the card before the call

actions.label: Archive a card
actions.description: Archive a card. A second call leaves it archived.

inputs.label: Card
inputs.description: The card id (24 hex characters) or the short link from its URL, trello.com/c/<shortLink>.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the path segment of /cards/{id}; an unknown id answers 400 with a plain-text body such as "invalid id", or 404.

outputs.description: True when the card is archived
Whether the due date is marked complete
The board the card is on
The list the card is in
Labels on the card: id, name, color
The short link in the card URL
When the card last changed, ISO 8601

actions.description: Read one card with its list and board.

inputs.label: Card
inputs.description: The card id (24 hex characters) or the short link from its URL, trello.com/c/<shortLink>.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the path segment of /cards/{id}; an unknown id answers 400 with a plain-text body such as "invalid id", or 404.

outputs.description: True when the card is archived
Whether the due date is marked complete
The board the card is on
The list the card is in
Labels on the card: id, name, color
The short link in the card URL
When the card last changed, ISO 8601
The list the card is in: id, name
The board the card is on: id, name, shortUrl

actions.label: List boards
actions.description: The boards the token’s member belongs to, open ones by default.

inputs.label: Filter
inputs.description: all, or a comma-separated list of closed, members, open, organization, public, starred. Defaults to open.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as filter on GET /members/me/boards; this route is under /members/, whose budget is 100 requests per 900 seconds.

outputs.description: One entry per board: id, name, desc, closed, idOrganization, url, shortUrl, dateLastActivity

actions.label: List lists on a board
actions.description: The lists of a board, open ones by default.

inputs.label: Board
inputs.description: The board id or the short link from its URL, trello.com/b/<shortLink>/….
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the path segment of /boards/{id}; the API accepts the short link in place of the id.

inputs.label: Filter
inputs.description: all, closed, none or open. Defaults to open.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as filter on GET /boards/{id}/lists.

outputs.description: One entry per list: id, name, closed, idBoard, pos

actions.label: List cards in a list
actions.description: The open cards of a list.

inputs.label: List
inputs.description: The id of the list.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the path segment of GET /lists/{id}/cards; the answer is one unpaged array.

outputs.description: One entry per card, in the card shape getCard returns

actions.label: Search cards
actions.description: Find cards matching a query across the member’s boards or the given ones.

inputs.label: Query
inputs.description: The search query, 1 to 16384 characters; Trello’s search operators such as due:week and label:red work here.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as query on GET /search with modelTypes=cards.

inputs.label: Board ids
inputs.description: mine, or a comma-separated list of board ids to search in. Blank searches every board the member can see.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as idBoards, comma-separated; whitespace around commas is removed.

inputs.label: Limit
inputs.description: The maximum number of cards to return, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 10.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as cards_limit; cards_page is not exposed, so one call reads one page.

inputs.label: Partial
inputs.description: Match content that starts with any of the words in the query.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as partial=true only when set.

outputs.description: The matching cards with their list and board
